items.name: Offset
items.description: Amount is offset of new edges from original

items.name: Width
items.description: Amount is width of new face

items.description: Amount is perpendicular distance from original edge to bevel face

items.description: Amount is percent of adjacent edge length

items.description: Amount is absolute distance along adjacent edge
